verdict.rationale: Gitea is self-hosted software deployable on any server, OS, or cloud (docs-9, docs-10, docs-13, docs-23), which inherently lets an operator choose the physical region/location where their Gitea instance and data reside — satisfying data residency by architecture rather than by an explicit named feature. However, there is no explicit documentation or feature describing region selection, multi-region replication, or data-residency guarantees as a formal capability. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency/region-selection documentation, multi-region deployment guidance, and any compliance-oriented residency features.
